pr_comments: @ColinJolivet looks like there are a couple of failing steps, one lint check and a failing test. Can you please take another look?

The lint check error is related to the lack of scope in the header of my commit message, I thought it was optional as it says in the contributing guideline. I'll correct this by adding a scope in my next commit.

But for the test failure, I'm not sure if it's related to what I did, and I can't reproduce the error in my environment, so I'm not sure what I can do to solve this problem. I'll look into it a bit further.
The test failure a is flaky test. Re-running it should fix it !

Thanks !

It did indeed solve the problem.

As for the lint problem, since I've already pushed the commit, do I have a way to modify it this way, or do I have to make a new one without any changes?

The linting job is triggered manually on our side. 
It will fail because of the merge commit. We'd like this change to be a single commit (this will require a drop & a squash).
The linting problem is resolve, i added the scope. Also, i squashed all the commits in one.
Could you make it a `refactor` commit. We keep `feat` for framework features. Thank you.

issue_context.title: Add hover tooltip on download button in Playground
issue_context.body: ### Describe the problem that you experienced As we know the cool angular.dev playground has a feature to download the provided/written source code. I find that at the first time of seeing/using this button it was pretty unclear to me what it does. First I thought it will just download the playground file I have currently open. ### Enter the URL of the topic with the problem https://angular.dev/playground ### Describe what you were looking for in the documentation _No response_ ### Describe the actions that led you to experience the problem _No response_ ### Describe what you want to experience that would fix the problem I suggest a tooltip below the button, that displays when hovering over the button, which says `Download the current application source code` or similar. https://material.angular.io/components/tooltip/overview ### Add a screenshot if that helps illustrate the problem ### If this problem caused an exception or error, please paste it here _No response_ ### If the problem is browser-specific, please specify the device, OS, browser, and version _No response_ ### Provide any additional information here in as much as detail as you can I'd be happy to implement this UX/Accessibility improvement. 😄
